scoring_justification: Load-bearing breakdown range is compared to the paper's gold with tolerance (result-level compare). Emission curve is structurally audited for plateau and avalanche shape. Full recompute of the breakdown from raw logs is infeasible because the verifier cannot re-run the Monte Carlo simulation.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper conclusion and Table I: breakdown range 11.5-12.5 MV/cm for crystalline SiO₂ from the present work.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's text and Table I.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported numbers, not synthetic.

outputs.description: The emission curve data, verified for structural features (plateau region below 10 MV/cm and a sharp increase around 11-13 MV/cm).
The extracted breakdown electric field range in MV/cm. Checked against the paper's reported range with a tolerance on each bound.

output_contract.notes: The emission curve provides a structural audit; the breakdown range is the primary headline result and is load-bearing.

steps.description: Verify that the emission curve has a plateau region (stable count) at low fields and a sharp increase indicating avalanche at higher fields.
Check that the reported breakdown range bounds are within tolerance of the paper's gold range.
